register.labelZh: CENTRE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: CENTRE 片語動詞能幫助你說明會議、課堂、書籍、電影或討論主要圍繞甚麼內容。；你可以說明某人如何以一個人物或構思為中心，安排課堂、活動、演講或故事。；你可以指出一件事真正集中在哪個重點，並把它與較不重要的內容作比較。；人們描述報告、專題、講座、電影、書籍和公開討論時，經常會使用 CENTRE 片語動詞。
register.summaryEn: CENTRE expressions help you explain what a meeting, lesson, book, film or discussion is mainly about. You can describe how someone organises a lesson, event, speech or story with one person or idea as its main focus. You can show what something centres on and contrast it with less important information. CENTRE expressions often appear when people describe reports, projects, talks, films, books and public discussions.
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句，選出意思相同的 CENTRE 片語動詞。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the CENTRE expression that gives the same meaning.
